title: Correction to: Phylogenetics of the supertribe Paulliniodae (Sapindaceae) with emphasis on chromosome evolution: taxonomic implications including the new genus Pacevedoa
content: This is a correction to: Juan D Urdampilleta, Eliana R Forni-Martins, María S Ferrucci, Phylogenetics of the supertribe Paulliniodae (Sapindaceae) with emphasis on chromosome evolution: taxonomic implications including the new genus Pacevedoa, Annals of Botany, Volume 135, Issue 7, 1 June 2025, Pages 1441–1458, https://doi.org/10.1093/aob/mcaf049
